# WMT Manufacturing Co. (Winding Machinery Traders)

> WMT Manufacturing Co., trading as Winding Machinery Traders, is a textile machinery manufacturer in Byculla, Mumbai, India. It makes precision cone, cheese and spool winding machines (WMT-PCP-08, WMT-50), ceramic yarn guides, ceramic/carbide yarn cutting blades and spare parts for ring frames, automatic cone winders (autoconers), TFO twisters and cheese/assembly winders, for customers in India and international markets.

The WMT-50 winder was the first machine of its kind manufactured indigenously in India, and thousands of WMT cheese, cone and spool winders have worked in rayon, nylon and sewing-thread plants. Brand names of other machine makers are used only to indicate spare-part compatibility.

## Company

- [Home](https://www.wmt-india.com/): Overview of WMT's winding machines, yarn-path components, spare parts and FAQs.

- [Contact](https://www.wmt-india.com/contact): Address, phone, fax, email and enquiry form for quotations.

## Products

- [All products](https://www.wmt-india.com/products): Winding machines, ceramic guides, cutters and spare-part ranges in one place.
- [WMT-PCP-08 Precision Winder](https://www.wmt-india.com/products/wmt-pcp-08-precision-winder): Six-spindle precision winder for soft dye packages, rewinding and 2-ply/3-ply packages; up to 1000 m/min, 150–200 mm traverse, individual inverter-driven spindles.
- [WMT-50 Cone & Cheese Winder](https://www.wmt-india.com/products/wmt-50-cone-cheese-winder): Cheese, cone and spool winder for natural and spun synthetic yarn and sewing thread; 200–450 m/min, 2″–6″ traverse, gear/belt gain, waxing and pineapple-cone attachments.
- [Ceramic Yarn Guides](https://www.wmt-india.com/products/ceramic-guides): Ceramic guides made from special high-tech alloys for guiding threads, forming and modifying the yarn path; reduce filament damage.
- [Ceramic / Carbide Cutting Blades](https://www.wmt-india.com/products/cutters): High edge-strength yarn cutters — faster cutting, no corrosion, smooth running without lubrication.

## Spare parts

- [All spare parts](https://www.wmt-india.com/spare-parts): Spare-part ranges organised by machine type.
- [Ring Frame Spares](https://www.wmt-india.com/spare-parts/ring-frame): ABC rings & holders, snail wires & lappets, outer grippers, spindle brakes, suction tubes, pegs & peg trays, roving guides and separators for Zinser, Toyoda, Howa, Rieter, LR-6 and Marzoli ring frames.
- [Auto Winding (Autoconer) Spares](https://www.wmt-india.com/spare-parts/auto-winding): Spares for Schlafhorst Autoconer 238 & 338, Murata Mach Coner 7-II & 7-VSS, and Savio Espero & Orion.
- [TFO Spares](https://www.wmt-india.com/spare-parts/tfo): TFO spares for V. Lakshmi, Prerna, Leehwa, Murata, Volkmann and Savio.
- [Cheese & Assembly Winder Spares](https://www.wmt-india.com/spare-parts/cheese-assembly-winder): Assembly winder spares for Textool, PS Mettler, SSM, Kamitsu and Murata.
